{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Growth Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of year-over-year changes in R&D expenses over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D expense growth may face higher uncertainty and thus higher required returns, as investors demand compensation for increased risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "CEO Portfolio Concentration", "construction": "percentage of CEO's net worth held in company stock, using ExecuComp data and proxy statements", "rationale": "CEOs with more concentrated portfolios may take on more risk, leading to higher expected returns for shareholders.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "number of distinct suppliers and customers, using trade publication data and 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains may face higher operational risks and thus higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Institutional Investor Attention", "construction": "number of distinct institutional investors holding the stock, using 13F filings", "rationale": "Firms with more institutional investor attention may face higher scrutiny and thus lower required returns, as investors are more informed.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Stock Option Expensivity", "construction": "value of employee stock options granted, using Compustat data and proxy statements", "rationale": "Firms with more expensively granted employee stock options may face higher agency costs and thus higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Interconnectedness", "construction": "number of shared board members with other firms, using proxy statements and BoardEx data", "rationale": "Firms with more interconnected boards may face higher risks of groupthink and thus higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Patent Citation Network Centrality", "construction": "number of citations received by a firm's patents, using USPTO data", "rationale": "Firms with more central patent citation networks may face higher risks of intellectual property disputes and thus higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Media Sentiment Dispersion", "construction": "standard deviation of media sentiment scores, using Dow Jones news archives", "rationale": "Firms with more dispersed media sentiment may face higher uncertainty and thus higher required returns, as investors demand compensation for increased risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Industry Relative Valuation Dispersion", "construction": "standard deviation of price-to-book ratios within an industry, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms in industries with higher relative valuation dispersion may face higher risks of mispricing and thus higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Turnover Rate", "construction": "percentage of employees leaving the firm, using Compustat data and 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with higher employee turnover rates may face higher human capital risks and thus higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
